## Change and reason

Describe what changed and why. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Verification

List the commands or interactions you checked and their results. Name the operating systems you actually tested, and note what you could not test. Include redacted before-and-after screenshots for visible UI changes when helpful.

## Compatibility

Mention changes to stored data, configuration, dependencies, permissions or setup steps. Write “None” if there are no such changes.

## Before submitting

- [ ] This pull request has one clear purpose.
- [ ] I ran the relevant tests, or explained why I could not run them.
- [ ] I updated the three READMEs if user-facing behavior or instructions changed.
- [ ] The diff and attachments contain no credentials, personal records, live configuration, private assets or generated runtime files.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute the included code and material.
